Paste a GCP service account JSON as the API key; the gateway exchanges it for an OAuth access token used by both protocols. A Vertex API key only works with Express / native Gemini `?key=`, not this OpenAI endpoint. Missing `google/` on OpenAI `provider_model_name` is added automatically (Gemini native stays unprefixed).
